how_this_works: Each hypothesis is falsifiable: it carries predictions with metrics and thresholds.
Signals (signal.* observations in Hydra) are assigned to a hypothesis parent.
Ideas declare hypothesis_parents; admission prefers aligned ideas and applies H1 as a hard filter via chatgpt_limits.json.
Periodically we compare each hypothesis' tracked series against its predictions -> status becomes playing_out / not_playing_out -> resources shift to playing hypotheses.

hypotheses.statement: Anything ChatGPT can do well is doomed as a separate product. Therefore maintain a list of things ChatGPT cannot do well; that list shrinks the problem space of what we build.

filter.mechanism: registry/chatgpt_limits.json capability classes; an idea whose core job falls outside every listed class is rejected at admission

predictions.claim: wrapper products whose core job is one good chat prompt plateau near zero recurring usage

hypotheses.statement: Build convenient tools for the agentic future such that it makes sense for agents to call them vs doing the work themselves — the tool must save tokens/time/effort or provide something chat lacks (live data, deterministic verification, persistence, side effects).

filter.mechanism: rubric features verifiability + data_access + low_integration_cost reward agent-convenience; WorkOrder spec must state the token-saving or capability delta

predictions.claim: agent-facing endpoints (machine-discoverable, typed, cheap) get disproportionate usage vs human-only pages
predictions.metric: ratio api.calls : web visits per product

predictions.claim: products exposing MCP tools see agent-origin traffic share grow over time

hypotheses.statement: Subscription models are dead — most people treat them like one-off purchases anyway. Given near-free compute, remake subscription SaaS from scratch and offer it free to maximize usage (usage is the asset: data, distribution, agent-dependency).

filter.mechanism: no auth/billing/subscription scaffolding in MVPs (already a Lane-A rule); incumbent_price signals justify unbundles; free serving cost must be ~0

predictions.claim: free-tier unbundles of paid incumbents reach usage parity with paid originals faster than paid clones would
incumbent prices in our niches rise while our free equivalents gain usage (arbitrage window open)
predictions.metric: signal.incumbent_price_min slope > 0 AND platform usage slope > 0
